name: How long does a typical bathroom sink installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom sink installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom sink installation typically takes 2-4 hours, assuming the plumbing is readily accessible and no significant modifications are required. The process can be extended if there's old plumbing to remove, countertop alterations needed for a new sink type, or if a new faucet is also being installed, which adds complexity. We aim to complete the work efficiently while ensuring proper seals and functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most installations take 2-4 hours, but complexity increases with plumbing modifications or countertop alterations.
